units.title: SG-5.6 · Admin round endpoints are provably mounted behind the admin token
Act: Confirm admin round routes are mounted from adminRoundRoutes in server.New
Act: Confirm RoundHandler maps service errors via statusFor
Verify: Mounted admin round routes return exact statuses with the admin token unit tests

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoundRoutesReturnHandlerStatuses
tests.title: Admin round routes return exact handler statuses with the admin token
tests.scenario: Given a server with admin.token tok and a temp repo holding the-boys-room and ROUND-0000001, when GET ROUND-0000001 (200 with id), GET ROUND-9999999 (404), and POST /api/v1/admin/rounds with body {bad (400) are sent with Bearer tok, then each status matches exactly
tests.detail: GET existing round -> 200 with id ROUND-0000001: PASS; GET unknown round -> 404: PASS; POST malformed body -> 400: PASS

units.title: Verify: Admin round handler status mapping unit tests

tests.name: TestRoundHandler_GetAndOpenStatuses/GET_/rounds/{id}_responds_200_with_the_round_JSON_when_found
tests.title: GET /rounds/{id} responds 200 with the round JSON when found
tests.scenario: Given a fake RoundService returning round ROUND-0000001, when GET /rounds/ROUND-0000001 is called, then the status is 200 and the JSON ID is ROUND-0000001

tests.name: TestRoundHandler_GetAndOpenStatuses/GET_/rounds/{id}_maps_ErrNotFound_to_404
tests.title: GET /rounds/{id} maps ErrNotFound to 404
tests.scenario: Given a fake RoundService returning an error wrapping ErrNotFound, when GET /rounds/ROUND-0000001 is called, then the status is 404

tests.name: TestRoundHandler_GetAndOpenStatuses/POST_/rounds/{id}/open_maps_ErrNotFound_to_404
tests.title: POST /rounds/{id}/open maps ErrNotFound to 404
tests.scenario: Given a fake RoundService returning an error wrapping ErrNotFound, when POST /rounds/ROUND-0000001/open is called, then the status is 404
